Retrieves the list of services running on an asset based on the specified asset ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/assets/:assetId/services

Retrieves the list of services running on an asset based on the specified asset ID. To learn more, see Understanding Asset Details.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

assetId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

REQUIRED

Default value: Bearer your-token
